# Copilot Instructions for LuuchoRocha Profile Repository

## Repository Overview

This is a personal GitHub profile repository that showcases my work as a Fullstack Developer. The repository contains my profile README with dynamic typing animations and GIFs.

## Project Structure

- `README.md` - Main profile page with animated content and personal branding
- `.github/` - GitHub configuration and Copilot instructions

## Code Style and Guidelines

### Markdown Files
- Use proper heading hierarchy (h1 for main titles, h2 for sections)
- Keep line length reasonable for readability
- Use consistent formatting for links and images
- Maintain alignment directives for centered content

### Content Guidelines
- Keep profile content professional yet personal
- Maintain the animated and dynamic feel of the profile
- Use external services like readme-typing-svg.demolab.com for animations
- Ensure all external links and image sources are valid and accessible

## Development Workflow

### Making Changes
- Test any changes to README.md by viewing the rendered Markdown
- Verify that external image URLs and animations load correctly
- Keep the profile content up-to-date with current skills and interests

### Best Practices
- Don't remove or break existing animations and visual elements
- Maintain the current visual style and branding
- Keep content concise and impactful
- Use HTML tags where necessary for advanced formatting (align, style attributes)

## Tech Stack
- Markdown for documentation
- HTML elements for advanced formatting
- External services for dynamic content (readme-typing-svg, user-images assets)

## Goals
- Showcase my identity as a Fullstack Developer
- Maintain an engaging and professional profile
- Keep content current and relevant
- Ensure all visual elements load and display correctly
